# windowsddi_dhcp_leases (Data Source)

Lists the leases of a scope (`Get-DhcpServerv4Lease`). Leases are runtime data: the result changes as clients come and go.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "windowsddi_dhcp_leases" "users" {
  scope_id = "10.1.20.0"
}

output "leased_hosts" {
  value = { for l in data.windowsddi_dhcp_leases.users.leases : l.ip_address => l.host_name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_id` (String) Scope to list leases for.

### Optional

- `all_leases` (Boolean) Also return offered, declined and expired leases (`-AllLeases`). Defaults to `false` (active leases only).

### Read-Only

- `leases` (Attributes List) Leases in the scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--leases))

<a id="nestedatt--leases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `leases`

Read-Only:

- `address_state` (String) Lease state, for example `Active`, `ActiveReservation` or `Expired`.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID (usually the MAC address), as `aa-bb-cc-dd-ee-ff`.
- `client_type` (String) Client type, for example `Dhcp`.
- `description` (String) Lease description.
- `host_name` (String) Host name reported by the client.
- `ip_address` (String) Leased IPv4 address.
- `lease_expiry_time` (String) Lease expiry time in RFC 3339 (UTC). Empty when the lease does not expire.
